setting.title: The Gannet Head Prism
setting.premise: Hester Gwynn grew up in the keeper's cottage at Gannet Head, and she has rented the decommissioned lighthouse back as a holiday let for the light's 150th anniversary weekend, with four guests and a relighting on Sunday night. On Friday night, in the first gale of the autumn, the glass prism her father saved from the old lens vanished from its oak cradle in the lantern room.
setting.missingItem: a fist-sized cut-glass prism from the old lighthouse lens, kept under velvet in an oak cradle
